{{Top|leg}}
A '''drogue slicer''' was a type of [[sky slicer]]. Drogue slicers were optional passenger attachments, providing their own upward lift but with no capacity for forward momentum. They were towed behind sky slicers using a low-power [[Tractor beam projector/Legends|tractor beam generator]].
